title: Verify: effectContext exhaustive return unit tests
summary: Test createEffect returns handles and throws on unknown
description: Unit tests with a mocked Phaser scene.
technical_constraints: Mock phaser with vi.mock; fake scene object

steps.action: vi.mock('phaser', () => ({ default: {} })); build a fake scene with add.particles/add.rectangle chained mocks and scale 320x180; call createPhaserEffectContext(scene, id => id).createEffect with a dust spec, an ambientLight spec (color '#112233', alpha 0.3) and a transition spec each plus depth 1, asserting a destroy function is returned; then call with { type: 'bogus', depth: 1 } cast to never and assert it throws /Unsupported effect type: bogus/.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/effectContextExhaustive.test.ts
